scope: Workflow rehearsal, real preprocessing functions, and analysis of externally supplied observations. No LLM trainer or end-to-end defense implementation is included.

commands.command: python run.py prepare --ordinary data/ordinary.jsonl --heterogeneous data/heterogeneous.jsonl --seed 2026 --output data/seed2026.json
commands.requires: Already extracted, English-filtered, category-verified input records.

commands.command: python run.py poison --partitions data/seed2026.json --attack text_backdoor --seed 2026 --output data/seed2026-backdoor.json

remaining_requirements: defense implementations and PEFT representation audit

commands.command: python run.py analyze --predictions measured_runs/RUN/predictions.jsonl --decisions measured_runs/RUN/client_decisions.jsonl --run-manifest measured_runs/RUN/manifest.json --output measured_runs/RUN/summary.json
commands.requires: Externally supplied complete observations and matching manifest hashes.

prepared_record_fields.product_id: product grouping key, e.g. Amazon parent_asin
prepared_record_fields.label: integer 0=negative or 1=positive

prediction_contract: One final-checkpoint prediction per test sample; 2000 per domain, labels balanced.
decision_contract: All 30 clients in all 50 rounds; H IDs18-23; IDs24-29 benign_designated under none, malicious otherwise; per-round normalized weights sum to 1.
fltrust_weight_contract: Normalized ReLU trust shares before update-norm rescaling; this is not an effective adapter coefficient.
summary_origin: Computed from supplied records; their real-world provenance is not independently certified.
reference_values: reference/table1.json; illustrative inputs, not measured results or three-seed estimates
